newsitem.title: USA: Asarco sees benefits from world econ. growth.
newsitem.headline: Asarco sees benefits from world econ. growth.

text.p: Asarco Inc said Wednesday it is positioned to benefit from continued world economic growth.

"Despite the decline in earnings due to lower copper prices, 1996 was a good year for Asarco," Chairman Richard de J. Osborne said. "At year-end, the company's debt as a percentage of total capital is 26.7 percent, very close to our long term goal of 25 percent.

"In addition, the company reached settlements with two of its insurance carriers to reimburse the company $42.3 million for environmental expenditures and $36.1 million of the settlements had been received by year-end.
"The settlements had no material impact on net earnings as a result of other adjustments to the company's reserve for environmental liabilities," Osborne noted.
Projecting continued worldwide economic growth, Osborne said, "Asarco is well positioned to benefit."

He said world "demand for copper is strong and it appears to us that supply and demand are in balance. At the same time, these favorable fundamentals appear to be replacing speculation as the primary influence in the copper market."
Measured in weeks of consumption, copper inventories in market warehouses are at their lowest levels since mid 1990.
